title: Red-Teaming Large Language Models using Chain of Utterances for Safety-Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to sensitive open-ended questions regarding race and systemic racism sourced from the PALMS dataset, as well as using the DangerousQA dataset which includes racist prompts.
Testing occupational gender stereotypes using pronoun fill-in-the-blank tasks from the Winogender dataset, and evaluating red-teaming success rates on sexist prompts from the DangerousQA dataset.
Using multiple-choice questions from the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) dataset to test the model's reliance on age-related stereotypes (e.g., older adults struggling with technology).
Analyzing model responses to red-teaming adversarial prompts from the HARMFULQA dataset designed to elicit harmful or shaming content regarding a person's sexuality.
